description: B3: boss_engaged for enemy.rootwarden (he wakes: a blow, or the woodfolk's call and the giant in his hollow) switches to the Matriarch's set (music.boss_matriarch: the Greywood's own boss music; the Rootwarden has no set of his own yet), after its intro stinger; boss_defeated plays the victory stinger, and an escape (boss_disengaged left) returns the music to the zone.
